## Explorer, Preview escape, Split clip, drag pan

- **Explorer**: Copy Path, Copy Relative Path, Reveal in File Manager; **Enter** on a file starts rename (folders still expand/collapse).
- **Preview-only escape**: Leaving Preview via title-bar Editor/Split, Ctrl+1/2/3, or sidebar toggle works again. Focus tracks the Typst live viewer; layout/sidebar actions are handled on the preview entity (they do not bubble to the workspace); title-bar calls `set_layout` directly.
- **Split right-edge clip**: `min_w_0` through the pane flex chain so the PDF toolbar and page cards can shrink inside Split instead of overflowing and clipping text and `Page`.
- **Drag pan**: click-hold pan caches list geometry and skips hit-test canvases/shadows while dragging so left/right/up pans stay smooth.
- **Typst sample**: heading numbering so `samples/nav-preview.typ` compiles to pages.
- **Single-click jump**: plain left-click on a Typst page jumps to source (flash + toast); drag starts after leaving click slop.
